title: NV2A SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM dispatch oracle (v0.3 — sentinel + control-row bisect; PASSES Metal/GL as of 2026-05-22 task #18 close)
purpose: 4x4 grid (16 cells) exercising PASS_THROUGH + PROGRAM_NONE at stage 0, plus two bisect rows for task #18 root-cause isolation. Row 0 (cells 0-3): PASS_THROUGH + combiner A=T0 + textured shaders; expected RED/GREEN/BLUE/WHITE. Row 1 (cells 4-7): PROGRAM_NONE + A=T0 + textured shaders; expected BLACK x4. Row 2 (cells 8-11, v0.3 sentinel): PROGRAM_NONE + sentinel combiner (A=B=INVERT(ZERO)=1.0) + textured shaders; expected WHITE x4 — completely independent of T0, V0, or shader-stage program; tests whether any combiner output reaches the framebuffer under textured-shader setup. Row 3 (cells 12-15, v0.3 control): PROGRAM_NONE + combiner A=V0/DIFFUSE + DEFAULT shaders (mid-frame xbed_load_default_shaders switch); expected RED/GREEN/BLUE/WHITE — tests whether the V0/DIFFUSE combiner path works when the textured-shader state machine is not involved. Stage 0 bound for all 16 cells to a 4x4 magenta dummy texture. Bisect interpretation: sentinel PASS + control PASS => candidate (a) textured-shader state-machine interaction is the lead cause; sentinel PASS + control FAIL => V0/DIFFUSE read broken independent of shader setup; sentinel FAIL + control PASS => draws under textured-shader state are silently discarded; sentinel FAIL + control FAIL => very fundamental SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM override issue independent of shader setup.
expected_fail_notes: RESOLVED 2026-05-22 (task #18 cycle 8). v0.3 bisect + two-fix close. Two root causes identified and fixed: (1) XBE combiner D_SOURCE bug: FINAL CW0 used D_SOURCE=0x0C (PS_REGISTER_R0) but the OCW AB_DST=0x4 writes to PS_REGISTER_V0 (0x04), not R0. R0 was never written, so FINAL read 0 -> BLACK for all rows. Fix: D_SOURCE 0x0C -> 0x04 in program_combiners_with_a_source() and program_combiners_sentinel(). This was the root cause of v0.2 ALL-BLACK results -- the v0.2 failures were XBE code bugs, not Metal renderer bugs. (2) PASS_THROUGH degradation: pgraph_is_texture_stage_active() (pgraph.h:327) returned false for mode 4 (PASS_THROUGH) due to 'mode != 4' exclusion. psh.c:145-146 then cleared the stage program bits -> PASS_THROUGH treated as NONE -> T0=0. Fix: removed 'mode != 4' from pgraph_is_texture_stage_active(); PROGRAM_NONE (0) is the only inactive mode. Affects both GL and Metal (shared code path). v0.3 final Metal result: all 16 cells PASS byte-exact (harness: 1 pass, 0 fail, 2026-05-22T04:29:05Z run). Bisect outcome: sentinel PASS + control PASS confirmed combiner executes under textured-shader state and V0/DIFFUSE works with default shaders; no SHADER_STAGE_PROGRAM Metal-specific dispatch issue exists.
